title: What people say about beginning again
intro: Short, anonymized reflections about finding language, setting boundaries, and returning to purpose.

sections.heading: “I finally named the question.”
sections.body: A dream conversation helped one visitor move from confusion to a useful next step.

sections.heading: “I needed less fear, not more.”

sections.heading: “I could honor my family and still choose.”
sections.body: An ancestral conversation became a bridge rather than a burden.
